prompt: The top of a soot-blackened gothic stone bell tower: a broken slate spire that leans hard to one side, its tip snapped off halfway up so the top ends in a jagged stump of splintered timber beams and torn slates, with a bent iron weathervane dangling from the break on a rusted rod. Missing slates leave dark holes in the spire and grime streaks run down it. Painted in a dark Victorian oil painting style with soft blended shading in near-black blue and charcoal tones, lit dimly and evenly. Plain flat solid bright green background around the spire, nothing else behind it.
